title: Unlock with Face ID
description: Short XRP Mobile tutorial: enable biometric authentication from Settings, Security, and open your wallet with Face ID instead of a PIN. The app locks as soon as it leaves the screen, iOS answers the biometric check itself so no face data ever reaches XRP Mobile, and your PIN still works as a fallback.
lede: Typing a PIN every time you open your wallet gets old, and every time you type it in public someone could be watching. Use your face instead.

steps.caption: Settings, then Security
steps.body: Open the gear and move to Security. Biometric authentication sits at the top, and it only appears if your phone actually has a face or a fingerprint enrolled.

steps.caption: Flip the switch
steps.body: Turn it on, and the phone asks you to prove yourself before it will accept the change.

steps.caption: Your face never leaves the phone
steps.body: Nothing about your face reaches XRP Mobile. iOS answers yes or no, and that is all the app ever sees.

shots.alt: Your face never leaves the phone

steps.caption: Close the app to test it
steps.body: Now close it properly and open it again. The wallet locks the moment it leaves the screen, which is what makes this worth doing.

shots.alt: Close the app to test it

steps.caption: It opens with a glance
steps.body: And you are in, without typing anything. Your PIN still works whenever the face fails, so you are never locked out of your own money.
